# Vendor artifacts (not included)

Place licensed ZKTeco SDK files here only on your private deployment/build system. This repository deliberately does not redistribute DLLs, OCXs, Android AAR/JARs, Linux `.so` files, manuals gated by partner login, firmware, license files, or activation keys.

Expected locations:
- `vendor/standalone-sdk/` — zkemkeeper / Standalone SDK runtime
- `vendor/plcommpro/` — access-panel PULL SDK (`plcommpro.dll`) runtime
- `vendor/zkfinger/windows/` — Windows ZKFinger native runtime
- `vendor/zkfinger/linux/` — Linux ZKFinger SDK runtime
- `vendor/android/` — Android ZKFinger SDK package
- `vendor/visible-light-sdk/` — visible-light / module SDK runtime
